title: Escaping Alignment: A Physical Trap Model of Best-of-N Jailbreaking
abstract: arXiv:2609.32116v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Best-of-$N$ jailbreaking (BoN) bypasses safeguards of aligned models by drawing $N$ independent augmentations of an unsafe prompt and sampling $M$ completions of each. Previous works have shown that the attack success rate (ASR) seems to follow a power-law in $N$, which we challenge. The exponent drifts with $N$, and the reported exponential crossover is consistent with a finite-size effect of the adversarial dataset. Little work has been done to explore the entire two-budget ($N, M$) attack surface as well as its dependence on the generation temperature $T$. We introduce a simple barrier model where each prompt has a baseline safety level and each augmentation a random thermally activated barrier. Then five numbers, each backed by an interpretable safety mechanism, determine the entire ($N, M$) attack surface. translated_title: 逃逸对齐：Best-of-N越狱攻击的物理陷阱模型
translated_abstract: Best-of-N（BoN）越狱攻击通过对一个不安全提示生成N个独立的改写版本，并对每个版本采样M个补全，从而绕过对齐模型的安全防护机制。以往研究表明，攻击成功率（ASR）似乎随N遵循幂律关系，我们对这一结论提出质疑：该幂律指数会随N发生漂移，而先前报告的指数式交叉行为实际上与对抗数据集的有限尺寸效应相一致。此前鲜有工作探索完整的双预算（N, M）攻击面，以及其对生成温度T的依赖关系。我们提出了一个简单的势垒模型：每个提示具有一个基线安全水平，而每个改写版本则对应一个随机的热激活势垒。在此模型下，五个参数——每个都由可解释的安全机制支撑——即可确定整个（N, M）攻击面。这些参数能够将预测从N ≤ 100外推至N = 10⁴，使五个不同的模型坍缩到同一标度函数上，并且（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一个基于热激活势垒的物理模型，仅用五个可解释参数即可完整刻画并将Best-of-N越狱攻击的双预算（N, M）攻击面从N≤100外推至N=10⁴，同时挑战了以往认为攻击成功率遵循幂律的观点，指出其源于数据集的有限尺寸效应。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a thermally activated barrier model with only five interpretable parameters that fully characterizes and extrapolates the entire two-budget (N, M) attack surface of Best-of-N jailbreaking from N≤100 to N=10⁴, while challenging the previously reported power-law scaling of attack success rate as a finite-size effect of the adversarial dataset.
